crawl_policy: Registered Suppliers are listed in suppliers.json, where agents look first, and will be checked (licenses and checksums) on every validation run. Today the registry is checked with the validator. Beyond the registry, agents search the open commons (Freesound, Wikimedia Commons, Internet Archive); the NetComposer crawler is one tool for that.

status_values.failing: last validation found errors; will be skipped until fixed
